tasks.instruction: Pytania o kulture i historie Wielkiej Brytanii. Z podanych odpowiedzi wybierz poprawna. Tylko jedna jest prawidlowa.

items.stem: What are the national symbols of Wales?
What is the protagonist's name in Charles Dickens' Christmas Carol?
Which of the following novels was not authored by Jane Austen?

options: D) The Guardians of the Tower

items.stem: What is the name of the circular space which stands at the heart of the British Museum, in the centre of the Great Court?
What happened to the original Globe Theatre in 1613?
options: A) It was destroyed by fire during a performance of Henry VIII.
B) It was dismantled and moved to a different location.
C) It was sold to a rival theatre company.
D) It was abandoned and fell into disrepair.

items.stem: What is the significance of the Magna Carta?
options: A) It established the Church of England as the official state religion.
B) It was a treaty that ended the Hundred Years' War.
C) It was a document in English constitutional history, limiting the powers of the monarch.
D) It granted voting rights to common citizens in medieval England.

items.stem: What was the primary purpose of the Act of Supremacy passed by the English Parliament in 1534?
options: A) To grant religious freedom to all citizens.
B) To establish the Church of England and declare the monarch as its supreme head.
C) To abolish the monarchy in England.
D) To ratify the Magna Carta.
